name: christmas-mugs-ad
description: MORZ, Hand-Painted Christmas Mugs: 15 s 9:16 ad for TikTok, Reels and Facebook Reels (Remotion + procedural sound).

scripts.mux: ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/mug-silent.mp4 -i public/mug.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -movflags +faststart -shortest christmas_mugs_ad.mp4
scripts.build: npm run sfx && npm run render && npm run mux
